ms.promise:
Objective:
Design and develop smart contracts at a prototype level.
・Develop smart contract source code with documentation
・Overview of the smart contracts and script specification
ms.criteria:
Acceptance Criteria:
・Develop smart contract source code:
・Data Flow Validation: The smart contract will demonstrate the ability to process inputs, perform logical operations, and output results
・Script Execution Validity: Smart contract scripts compile, execute, and validate transactions
・Test Cases for Core Logic: Functional source code will include test cases to validate key logical flows, ensuring that the core functionality behaves as designed.
・A document detailing the overview of smart contracts and script specifications.
ms.report:
We have completed the prototype-level design and development of the smart contract. The data flow and script execution have been properly compiled, tested, and validated. Supporting documentation has been prepared in accordance with the specified milestone outputs and acceptance criteria. All relevant materials are now available on our public GitHub repository for open access and community feedback.
・Smart Contract Repository: Smart_contract
・Smart Contract Documentation & Readme: Documentation.md
・Test Cases for Core Logic Readme: Accessible via the GitHub repository

Acceptance Criteria:
・Smart contracts are deployed on the Cardano preproduction testnet and mainnet.
